posts.name: saki.neko
posts.cooked:
As someone who hasn't been able to plow through all the reading material that exists in Sentinels world, I haven't the broad base of knowledge to answer this question for myself.  Are there heroes in the SOTM world, either villains or heroes, with gender or sexuality that falls outside of societal norms?  Is Visionary asexual?  Is the wraith a lesbian with a secret, doomed crush on the Ermine?  Is it reciprocated?  Technically I suppose Omnitron X can be considered agendered if it so desires, but are there others who may be gender fluid etc.  Thoughts, speculations, proof?  I'm very curious.

 

PS, a lesbian young Legacy would be fuel for some of my own romantic fantasies :P  I bet she gives killer backrubs.

posts.name: Reckless
posts.cooked:
I think the extent of our knowledge on non-straight characters are Tachyon and Medico. Omnitron-X and Tempest are genderless, but I don’t know if they have a preferred pronoun.

Wraith has a tragic backstory involving a boyfriend so we know that she’s attracted to men at least. Finest Legacy has a wife, Absolute Zero had a fiancee (is that the feminine? He was dating a woman, either way), and Expatriette has been strongly implied to be romantically involved with Setback.

Beyond that? I’m not sure. Nothing is preventing any of these characters from being sexually attracted to more than just the opposite sex, but this is what we’ve heard so far.
